svco.toast.title: Simple Voice Online
svco.msg.connected: Voice chat connected through relay (only relay users can hear you)
svco.msg.reconnecting: Voice relay lost (%s), retrying in %ss — attempt %s of %s
svco.msg.gave_up: Voice relay: giving up after %s failed attempts. Use the settings screen to retry.
svco.update.required: Update %s is REQUIRED — the relay protocol changed, voice will not work until you update
svco.update.required_missing: This version is no longer accepted by the relay — a mod update is required
svco.update.installed: Update %s downloaded — restart the game to apply
svco.update.installed_required: Required update %s downloaded — restart the game to get voice back
svco.update.failed: Automatic update failed (%s) — please update manually from Modrinth
svco.gui.title: Simple Voice Online
svco.gui.reconnect.tooltip: Drop the current relay session (or the retry countdown) and connect again right now
svco.gui.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, the mod never touches voice chat. Turning it on while playing connects immediately.
svco.gui.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Automatically retry when the relay connection fails or drops, with increasing delays (5s, 10s, 20s...)
svco.gui.distance.tooltip: How far your voice carries, in blocks
svco.gui.max_attempts.tooltip: How many reconnect attempts before giving up. Slide to the far left for unlimited.
svco.gui.detect_timeout.tooltip: After joining a server, how long to wait for its own voice chat before falling back to the relay
svco.gui.punch_timeout.tooltip: How long to try a direct peer-to-peer connection before staying on the relay path
svco.gui.check_updates.tooltip: Ask the relay server for new mod releases on Modrinth at game start
svco.gui.auto_update.tooltip: Download new releases into the mods folder automatically; applied after a restart
svco.gui.toast_notifications.tooltip: Announce relay connects/disconnects as pop-up toasts
svco.gui.relay_url.tooltip: Address of the standalone relay server. Applies to the next (re)connect.
svco.gui.proxy.button.tooltip: Route all relay and peer-to-peer traffic through a SOCKS5 proxy, so neither the relay nor other players see your IP address
svco.gui.proxy.title: SOCKS5 Proxy
svco.gui.proxy.intro: Signaling, relayed voice, direct peer-to-peer voice and update checks all go through the proxy, so the relay and other players only see the proxy's address. The proxy must support UDP (UDP ASSOCIATE). If it fails, voice stays off — it never falls back to a direct connection.
svco.gui.proxy.enabled.tooltip: When on, nothing is sent to the relay or to peers except through the proxy. Applies immediately on Done.
svco.gui.proxy.host.tooltip: Host name or IP address of the SOCKS5 proxy
svco.gui.proxy.username.tooltip: Leave empty if the proxy needs no authentication
svco.gui.proxy.password.tooltip: Stored in plain text in config/svco.json
svco.gui.proxy.test.tooltip: Check that the proxy accepts the login, reaches the relay and supports UDP — using the values typed above
svco.gui.proxy.test.ok: ✔ Proxy works: relay reachable over TCP (%s ms), UDP relayed by the proxy at %s
svco.status.detecting: Checking the server for voice chat...
svco.status.server_voice.detail: This server has voice chat — the relay is not needed
svco.status.connected.alone: No other relay users on this server yet
